src: APPSC Sociology Back Log 2002
s: In a patriarchal society, the principle that the mother's brother plays the most important and ritualistic social role is called this.
x: In a patrilineal (patriarchal) society the ritual and social role of the mother's brother reflects complementary filiation (Meyer Fortes) – the tie with the mother's kin; consanguinity is mere blood relationship. Same item as the 'complementary filiations' question (printed key here: A).

src: APPSC Sociology Back Log 2000
s: The notion that man is stronger than woman is a
x: 'Man is stronger than woman' is a belief, a proposition accepted as true (the same item elsewhere is keyed 'belief'); 'Trust' here translates belief (nammakam). A value is a judgement of what is desirable, not a factual claim (printed key: Value).

src: Social Structure, Issues and Public Policies 2016
s: Declaration of the rights of children took place in
x:
The printed options did not include the correct answer (1959); it is added as option 5.
The UN General Assembly adopted the Declaration of the Rights of the Child on 20 November 1959 (the Geneva Declaration was 1924; the UNCRC 1989). None of 1947, 1951, 1953 or 1958 is correct.

src: APPSC Sociology General Studies 2000
s: Divorce occurs when
o: When husband and wife decide to live separately
When both spouses inform their parents
When the society believes that their marriage bond is broken
When the marriage is annulled by the court
x: Divorce is the legal dissolution of a marriage by a court (W.P. Scott: an institutionalised arrangement for terminating the marriage); spouses merely deciding to live apart is separation, not divorce.

src: APPSC Polytechnic Colleges Lecturers (Engineering & Non-Engi
s: The government of Andhra Pradesh had signed an MoU with NDMA on 13 August 2021 for ERSS implementation in the state. What is the full form of ERSS
x:
The printed options did not include the correct answer (Emergency Response Support System); it is added as option 5.
ERSS is the Emergency Response Support System (single number 112). None of the printed options is the correct expansion: option (d) swaps 'Response' and 'Support', and the others are invented.

src: APPSC Civil Assistant Surgeon (Specialist) in AP Vaidya Vidh
s: Which of the following is a better way of protecting reserve forests?
o: Keeping them out of bounds for locals
Allowing limited rights like grazing rights to locals
Privatization of forest management through big corporates
x: Allowing limited rights such as grazing gives locals a stake in protecting reserve forests; total exclusion, unlimited rights or corporate privatisation do not.

src: APPSC AEE Electrical Engineering Screening Test General Stud
s:
Which of the following is/are correct about East Asia Summit?

a. 13th East Asia Summit held in Singapore.

b. It is an ASEAN-Centered Forum.

c. It can only be chaired by an ASEAN Member.

d. East Asia Summit comprises the ten member states of the ASEAN.
x: a, b and c are correct: 13th EAS in Singapore (2018), ASEAN-centred, chaired only by an ASEAN member. d is wrong – the EAS has 18 members, not just the ten ASEAN states; so 'all of the above' is wrong.

src: APPSC Sociology General Studies 2000
s: Tribal economic relations mainly depended on this
x: Tribal economic relations depended mainly on barter; the jajmani system links castes in a village, not tribes (printed key: jajmani).

src: APPSC Group-III Panchayat Secretary Screening Test GS-MA 201
s: The gender focal points, gender desks, gender budgeting cells set up in Ministries, State Government Departments, Panchayats and Urban local bodies serve as a focal point for
o: Advancing data collection on various issues affecting women that require immediate attention and intervention
x: The gender focal points, gender desks and gender budgeting cells are meant as focal points for advancing gender-disaggregated data collection on issues needing immediate intervention (Draft National Policy for Women 2016 approach).

src: APPSC Group-III Panchayat Secretary Mains Paper-II 2017
s: Who can dissolve the Gram Panchayat, if the constitutional powers are misused
o: Panchayat cannot be dissolved before its term
x: If a Gram Panchayat abuses its powers the State Government (through the administration) can dissolve it; a panchayat can be dissolved before its term, with fresh polls within six months.

src: Civil Services (Preliminary) 1993
s: What do you call a family where there is division between 'Biological father' and 'social father'?
x: Separation of the biological father (genitor) from the social father (pater) occurs in polyandrous, i.e. polygamous, families, as among the Toda, where a rite fixes the social father (printed key: Patriarchal family).

src: APPSC Deputy Executive Information Engineers & Inspector of
s: The 10th BRICS summit Declaration was named as
x: The 10th BRICS Summit (Johannesburg, South Africa, July 2018) adopted the Johannesburg Declaration.

src: APPSC Zilla Sainik Welfare Officer (Sainik Welfare Service)
s: The Halifax Summit was the meeting of
o: Countries in favour of a common currency in Europe
x: The Halifax Summit (Canada, June 1995) was a G7 summit.

src: Civil Services (Preliminary) 1999
s: What is a radical cultural movement arising when there is evolution called?
x:
Printed keys split: transformational (this copy) vs millenarian (the 1996 copy); the stem is a garbled translation and the original key could not be found.
Garbled stem: a movement promising radical cultural change in times of extreme upheaval is usually called a millenarian movement; the two printings of this question carry different keys (transformational / millenarian).

src: APPSC Fisheries Development Officer, Assistant Inspector of
s: Which of the following was prepared and released by the NITI Aayog?
x: NITI Aayog prepared and released 'Strategy for New India @ 75' (December 2018).

src: APSLPRB Final Written Exam 2019
s: English is the official language of the following state in India.
x: English is the official language of Nagaland; Goa uses Konkani, Uttarakhand Hindi (and Sanskrit), Assam Assamese.

src: APPSC Junior Assistant in Inter Board 2012
s: When did Indian Penal Code come into effect?
x:
The printed options did not include the correct answer (1862); it is added as option 5.
The IPC was enacted on 6 October 1860 but came into force on 1 January 1862; 1860 is the year of enactment, and 1852, 1854, 1857 are wrong.

src: APPSC Sample Taker 2023
s: In May 2023, the Supreme Court said that "it can exercise its powers under Article ___ of the constitution to grant divorce on the ground of irretrievable breakdown of a marriage" even if one of the parties opposes it.
x: In May 2023 (Shilpa Sailesh) the Supreme Court held it can use Article 142(1) to grant divorce on irretrievable breakdown of marriage even if one party opposes.

src: Grama Ward Sachivalayam Ward Education & Data Processing Sec
s: These rights enable men to have a reasonable and legal source of livelihood.
x: Economic rights secure a person a reasonable and legal source of livelihood (work, wages, leisure). Liberty and religion are civil rights; education is a social-cultural right.

src: APPSC Sociology Backlog 2002
s: Which of the following is an example of a community ?
x: No key can be settled: in MacIver's sociology a club and a religious establishment are associations (organised for specific interests), not communities, so the printed key 'a club related to sports' contradicts the textbook distinction; family and kinship groups are treated as both community and association by different authors, so the question has no single defensible answer.

src: APPSC Welfare Organiser in A.P Sainik Welfare Sub Service Ge
s: From which of the following countries were 4000 Indian nationals evacuated, due to the civil war, by launching the operation called 'Rahat'
x: Operation Rahat (April 2015) evacuated over 4,000 Indians and many foreigners from war-torn Yemen through Aden and Al Hudaydah via Djibouti.

src: APPSC Group-III Mains Panchayat Secretary (Grade-IV) Paper-I
s: A cash book is used to:
at: Record receipts and payments of cash
x: A cash book records all cash receipts and cash payments in order of date, the cash counterpart of the ledger account. (Moved: Panchayati Raj finances.)

src: TSPSC CDPO Paper-II 2023
s: Which one of the following is NOT matched correctly with regard to the Governing Board of the Rashtriya Mahila Kosh (RMK)?
o: Minister of State, Women & Child Development: Member (Ex-officio)
Minister of Women & Child Development: Chairperson (Ex-officio)
x: The Prime Minister has no post on the RMK Governing Board: the Union Minister of Women and Child Development chairs it (ex officio) and the Executive Director is Member-Secretary. So 'PM: Honorary President' is the wrong pair.

src: APPSC Sociology General Studies 2000
s: It is said that marriage is a source of kinship. Who said this?
x: The printed key credits Westermarck (History of Human Marriage) with the view that marriage is a source of kinship; Radcliffe-Brown defined kinship as dynamic relations regulated by social usage.

src: SI Preliminary Paper-II 2016
s:
Sukanya Samriddhi Account is a scheme having which of the following

a) To promote the welfare of the girl child

b) A minimum deposit is Rs. 10,000

c) A savings account can be opened by the parent or legal guardian of a girl child less than 10 years

d) The interest that is provided on the deposited amount is tax free
x: Sukanya Samriddhi (2015, Beti Bachao Beti Padhao) promotes the girl child; a parent or guardian can open it for a girl under 10; interest is tax-free (EEE). The minimum deposit was ₹1,000 at launch (now ₹250), not ₹10,000, so it is a, c and d.

src: Civil Services (Preliminary) 1999
s: Who among the following proposed the tribe-caste model to explain the process of tribal amalgamation?
x: Surajit Sinha proposed the tribe-caste (tribe-peasant) continuum model to explain how tribes were absorbed into caste society; N.K. Bose gave the 'Hindu method of tribal absorption'.

src: APPSC Sociology Backlog 2002
s: In India 'Rythu' (Peasant) means
o: Own land and cultivate it with hired labour
Own land and cultivate it with the labor of family members.
Those who use traditional farming practices
x: A peasant (rythu, kisan) owns or holds land and cultivates it mainly with family labour – Thorner's 'kisan'; one who cultivates through hired labour is a landlord-farmer (malik) (printed key: A).

src: APPSC Sociology Backlog 2002
s: Which of the following is true about sociology?
o: It is the scientific study of society
It is concerned with the behavior of individuals in society
It studies groups and their organizations
Its purpose is to eliminate evils in the society
x: Sociology is the scientific study of society (A), the standard definition; it studies groups and behaviour in society too, but its aim is not to eliminate evils (printed key: B, which is only part of its scope).

src: APSLPRB SI Paper-II Prelims 2018
s: The Godavari river water dispute is going on among the following states:
o: Maharashtra, Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Bihar, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh
Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Odisha, Karnataka, Chhattisgarh, Maharashtra
Maharashtra, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Bihar, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh
Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Bihar, Odisha, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh
x: The Godavari basin States – Maharashtra, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Odisha, Karnataka (and MP) – are the parties; Bihar is not in the basin.

src: APPSC ASO 2011
s: The head quarters of International Labour Organization (ILO) is
x: The ILO (1919) has its headquarters in Geneva, Switzerland.

src: Civil Services (Preliminary) 1997
s: False consciousness in caste stratification is due to
o: They are hindered in awareness of their role in the system
They are hindered awareness of their demands
x: In the Marxian sense, false consciousness in caste means the lower castes are kept from seeing their real status (their exploitation) in the system. Option 3 says this; the options are loose translations, and the printed key was missing.

src: Civil Services (Preliminary) 1998
s:
Which of the following tribes practice couvade?

A. Khasi

B. Toda

C. Spoon

D. Ho
Select the correct answer using the codes given below.
x: Couvade (kuhana prasuti – the husband imitating his wife's pregnancy and birth taboos) is reported among the Khasi and the Toda, i.e. A and B; 'Spoon' is a garbled item and the Ho are not the textbook example (printed key: B, C, D).

src: AP Grama Ward Sachivalayam Ward Welfare & Development Secret
s: Recently enacted the Surrogacy (Regulation) Act, 2019 allows ethical altruistic surrogacy to the intending infertile Indian married couple between the age of
o: 21-50 years and 26 - 55 years for female and male, respectively
18-45 years and 21 - 50 years for female and male, respectively
23 - 50 years and 26 - 55 years for female and male, respectively
21- 46 years and 21 - 50 years for female and male, respectively
x: The Surrogacy (Regulation) Bill 2019 (Act 2021) permits altruistic surrogacy for a married Indian couple with the wife aged 23-50 and the husband 26-55.

src: APPSC Group-III Mains Panchayat Secretary (Grade-IV) Paper-I
s: The District level Administrative Authority of the Gram Panchayat
x: The district-level administrative authority over gram panchayats is the Collector (Panchayat Raj) – printed key.

src: Civil Services (Preliminary) 1998
s: Levirate is practiced in which societies?
x: Levirate - a widow marrying her dead husband's brother - keeps the widow, her children and property within the husband's lineage, so it belongs to patriarchal (patrilineal) societies. (Moved to the marriage row of Society.)

src: APPSC ASO Mains 2017
s: To which Agency, Supreme Court entrusted the probe of alleged cases of forcible conversion and marriage referred as 'Love Jihad' cases?
x: In August 2017 (Hadiya case) the Supreme Court asked the National Investigation Agency to probe the alleged 'love jihad' conversion and marriage in Kerala.

src: TSPSC CDPO Paper-II 2023
s: Robert Redfield while defining little community talks about four characteristics. Three of them aredistinctiveness, smallness, and self-sufficiency. Which one is the fourth?
x: Redfield's little community has four traits: distinctiveness, smallness, homogeneity and self-sufficiency. Heterogeneity is an urban trait.

src: APPSC Group-III Panchayat Secretary Mains Paper-II Rural Dev
s: Which of the following is not a source of funds for Gram Panchayat?
x: Taxes, Central grants and loans are all GP funding sources; fees on services to SHGs are not one (SHGs are partners, not a revenue base).

src: APPSC Group-III Panchayat Secretary Mains Paper-II Rural Dev
s: Who has the primary responsibility to report outbreak of an epidemic in a village?
o: All the given answers are correct
x: The Panchayat Secretary has the primary responsibility to report an epidemic outbreak in the village (printed key).

src: APPSC Assistant B.C. Welfare Officer, Assistant Social Welfa
s: Which of the following States has the lowest concentration of tribal population?
x: Tripura has about 32% STs (Census 2011), the lowest share among the North-Eastern tribal States, which are tribal-majority (Mizoram, Nagaland, Meghalaya, Arunachal). If Assam were an option it would be lower (about 12%); the app shows no options.

src: APPSC Group-III Panchayat Secretary Mains Paper-II 2017
s: Who exercises control over the Panchayat Secretary?
o: All the given answers are correct
x: The Sarpanch, as executive head, exercises control over the Panchayat Secretary.

src: APPSC Hostel Welfare Officers (Grade-II) General Studies & M

at: MHRD minister as head and secretary of Department of School Education and Literacy as vice-chairperson
x: The RMSA National Mission was headed by the Union HRD Minister, with the Secretary, Department of School Education and Literacy, as vice-chairperson.

src: APPSC Group-III Panchayat Secretary Mains Paper-II Rural Dev
s: For selection of beneficiary in PMAY (Gramin), who would conduct verification of housing deprivation data?
x: Under PMAY-G the SECC-based list of housing-deprived households is verified by the Gram Sabha before beneficiaries are finalised.

src: APPSC Forest Range Officers Mains General Studies & Mental A
s: Which country is NOT a part of the BIMSTEC organisation?
x: BIMSTEC has seven members – Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Nepal, Sri Lanka, Myanmar and Thailand; China is not one.

src: TSPSC CDPO 2023
s:
Which of the following problems are associated with transgenders?

A. Denial of access to education

B. Absence of special healthcare services for transgender people

C. Denial and lack of access to food and clothing

D. Lack of identity and social acceptance transgenders

E. Forced to make a living by begging and working as sex workers
Select the correct answer:
o: A, B, D and E only
A, C, D and E only
x: Transgender persons commonly face denial of education, lack of special healthcare, lack of identity and social acceptance, and are forced into begging or sex work; denial of food and clothing is not among the standard listed problems. Off-topic, moved to transgender persons.

src: Civil Services (Preliminary) [year unreadable]
s: What is a group of relatives who are all consanguineous relatives called?
x: A group of kin all related by blood (consanguineous) is a cognatic (cognate) group: cognates are blood relatives through both lines, agnates only through males, uterine kin only through females. 'Homogeneous group' is not a kinship term (printed key: Homogeneous group, probably a mistranslation).

src: TSPSC Extension Officer Paper-II 2023
s: Jan Bremen's work on village studies focused on
x: Jan Breman's village studies in south Gujarat focused on the Halpati labourers bound as hali to Anavil landowners (Patronage and Exploitation).

src: TSPSC CDPO Paper-II 2023
s: A national Curricular and Pedagogical Framework for Early Childhood Care and Education for children up to the age of 8 prepared by NCERT is in:
x: NCERT's National Curricular and Pedagogical Framework for ECCE (up to 8 years) has two parts: 0–3 and 3–8 years.

src: APPSC Hostel Welfare Officer Grade-II (Male & Female) in AP
s: Application of principles of sociology to education is known as?
x: Educational sociology is the application of the general principles and findings of sociology to the process and administration of education (F.J. Brown). Sociology of education, a later field, is the sociological analysis of education as a social institution, so the 'application' definition points to educational sociology (printed key: Sociology of education).

src: APPSC Forest Beat Officer & Assistant Beat Officer Screening
s: The process of keeping a carefull watch on specific events or activities, which constitute the main components of the programme is called
x: Monitoring is keeping a careful watch on the specific events or activities that make up a programme while it runs; evaluation judges its results.

src: Civil Services (Preliminary) 1996
s: Who said 'Religion is a heart for the heartless'?
x: Marx called religion 'the sigh of the oppressed creature, the heart of a heartless world' and 'the opium of the people' (1844).

src: APPSC Junior Lecturers 2004
s: Excluding Uttar Pradesh, the state which sends maximum number of representatives to the Lok Sabha is
x:
The printed options did not include the correct answer (Maharashtra); it is added as option 5.
Maharashtra (48 seats) sends the most Lok Sabha members after Uttar Pradesh (80); of the printed options Bihar has 40, Tamil Nadu 39 and Madhya Pradesh 29 (Bihar had 54 only before its 2000 bifurcation) (printed: no key).

src: APPSC Asst. BC & Tribal Welfare Officers Mains Paper-II 2017
s: Who was the founder of BCT (Bhagavathula Charitable Trust) in Vishakhapatnam District?
x: Bhagavatula Charitable Trust (Yellamanchili, Visakhapatnam district), a rural development NGO, was founded by B.V. Parameswara Rao.

src: Paper header illegible
s:
Consider the following organisations:

1. International Bank for Reconstruction and Development

2. International Finance Corporation

3. International Fund for Agricultural Development

4. International Monetary Fund
Which of these are agencies of the UN?
x: IBRD, IFC, IFAD and IMF are all specialized agencies of the UN system (IBRD and IFC as World Bank Group members).

src: APPSC Hostel Welfare Officer Grade-II (Male & Female) in AP
s: What are the basic features of a community according to MacIver?
o: A group of people sharing the basic conditions of life
Geographic territory and uniformity of conduct
Likeness and differences between the group members
Geographic territory and sense of solidarity
x: MacIver and Page name two bases of a community: locality (a definite territory) and community sentiment (we-feeling, a sense of solidarity), i.e. option D. 'A group sharing the basic conditions of a common life' (A) is MacIver's definition of community, not its features (printed key: A).

src: APPSC Sociology Back Log 2002
s: When a person dies, his immovable property is transferred from one person to another. This is
x: Transfer of a dead person's property to heirs is inheritance; adoption is taking another's child as one's own.

src: APPSC AEE Screening Test 2016
s: "Bachpan Bachao Andolan" is founded by
x: Bachpan Bachao Andolan (1980) was founded by Kailash Satyarthi (Nobel Peace Prize 2014); Bezwada Wilson founded the Safai Karmachari Andolan.

src: APPSC Asst. Social, BC & Tribal Welfare Officers Screening T
s: If a person wants to set up a minority educational institute, out of the following, whose permission is mandatory?
o: Department of Education of the concerned State Government
National Commission for Minority Educational Institutions
x: Under Section 10 of the NCMEI Act 2004, a person setting up a minority educational institution needs a No Objection Certificate from the competent authority of the State Government (its Department of Education). The NCMEI hears appeals and the NCM has no role in permission.

src: APPSC Fisheries Development Officer, Sericulture Officer, Ag
s: Jharkhand Janjatiya Mahotsav was celebrated on ____, in which artists from tribal-dominated states, including the north-eastern states of India participated.
x: The Jharkhand Janjatiya Mahotsav was held on 9-10 August 2022 in Ranchi, starting on the International Day of the World's Indigenous Peoples (9 August).

src: APPSC Junior Lecturers General Studies & Mental Ability 2020
s: From which country has India procured Apache AH-64E(I) helicopters?
x: India procured AH-64E(I) Apache attack helicopters from the USA (Boeing); the IAF inducted them in 2019.

src: State PSC
s: Which among the following European Union countries is the first to officially recognize the State of Palestine?
x: Sweden (October 2014) was the first EU member state to recognise the State of Palestine while a member of the EU.

src: APPSC Forest Section Officer General Studies & Mental Abilit
s: Critical examination of the assembled and grouped data for studying the characteristics of the object under study is called
x: Critical examination of the assembled and grouped data to study the characteristics of the object is data analysis (the step before interpretation).

src: APPSC Sociology Backlog 2002
s: "Culture is the part created by man in the environment". Who said this ?
x: 'Culture is the man-made part of the environment' is M.J. Herskovits's definition (Man and His Works, 1948). Tylor defined culture as a 'complex whole' of knowledge, belief, art, morals, law and custom, and Malinowski as inherited artefacts, goods and ideas, so 'None of the above'.

src: APPSC Assistant Social, BC & Tribal Welfare Officers Screeni
s: Under the Commission of Sati (Prevention) Act, 1987, maximum term of imprisonment for glorification of Sati is
x: Under s.5 of the Commission of Sati (Prevention) Act, 1987 glorification of sati is punishable with 1 to 7 years and fine of ₹5,000-30,000; abetting sati carries death or life (s.3-4).

src: Social Structure, Issues and Public Policies 2016
s: The sense of "We feeling" is most strong in
x: The 'we-feeling' is the mark of primary groups (Cooley), and the family is the primary group where it is strongest. The printed key (class) contradicts this: class is a loose, impersonal stratum. Strictly it depends on the source book's framing; the owner should check.

src: SSC 2018
s: The phrase ‘Survival of the fittest’ as a way of describing the mechanism of natural selection was coined by
x: Herbert Spencer coined 'survival of the fittest' in Principles of Biology (1864) after reading Darwin.

src: Civil Services (Preliminary) 2001
s: Economic relations between tribes are mostly based on what?
x: Economic relations between tribes rest mainly on barter and exchange; the jajmani system is a hereditary service relation between castes of a settled village, not a tribal institution (printed key: jajmani).

src: Civil Services (Preliminary) [year unreadable]
s: When a group of people gets excited and engages in or prepares to engage in violent action, what is the group called?
x:
The printed options did not include the correct answer (Mob); it is added as option 5.
An excited crowd that engages in or prepares for violent action is a mob. A crowd is any temporary gathering, a gang is a small organised group and an aggregation is a mere collection, so no printed option fits.

src: APPSC Forest Section Officer General Studies & Mental Abilit
s: Noted Indian-American economist who is the Chief Economist of IMF
x:
Gita Gopinath was IMF Chief Economist 2019-21, then First Deputy MD (Jan 2022 – Aug 2025) — now the Chief Economist is Pierre-Olivier Gourinchas (since January 2022) (general knowledge, not checked)
Gita Gopinath was the IMF's Chief Economist from January 2019 (first woman) and later its First Deputy MD (2022-25); the Chief Economist now is Pierre-Olivier Gourinchas.

src: APPSC Hostel Welfare Officer Grade-II (Male & Female) in AP
s: The following evaluation (sometimes referred to as internal) is a method for judging the worth of a program while the program activities are forming (in progress).
x: Formative (internal) evaluation judges a programme while its activities are forming; summative evaluation comes at the end.

src: APPSC Group-IV Prelims General Studies & Mental Ability 2022
s: Who is the Head of the International Monetary Fund Asia and Pacific Department?
x: Krishna Srinivasan became Director of the IMF's Asia and Pacific Department in 2022; Viral Acharya and Urjit Patel were RBI officials and S.C. Garg a finance secretary. IMF question, moved.

src: APPSC Assistant Statistical Officer Screening Test 2017
s: Which is the highest forum of debate in the country?
x: Parliament is the highest forum of debate in the country; courts adjudicate, and media and civil society inform debate outside the State.

src: Civil Services (Preliminary) 1994
s: In which tribe touching the plow (plough) and filling the house are prohibited for women?
x: Among the Santhals, women are forbidden to touch the plough and to thatch (cover) the roof of a house. 'Qadiah' is not a tribe name; the printed key (option 1) looks like a garbled entry.

src: APPSC Assistant Director 2017
s: Who are the maximum sufferers during a drought?
x: Women suffer most in droughts – they fetch water and fuel, eat last, lose farm wages and face migration of men.

src: APPSC AP Municipal Junior Accounts Officers 2012
s: Under which Article of the Indian Constitution do the State Legislatures have the right to delegate powers and authority to Municipalities ?
x: Article 243W lets the State Legislature endow Municipalities with powers and authority; 243V is disqualification, 243Z audit, 243S ward committees.

src: TSPSC CDPO Paper-II 2023
s: People decide that living together with committed intimate, sexual relationships which also provides a way to share daily life is seen
x: Two partners who choose to live together in a committed intimate relationship, sharing daily life without marrying, are cohabiting; marriage needs social and legal sanction, and singlehood means living without a partner.

src: APPSC Junior Lecturers General Studies & Mental Ability 2020
s: During his regime, Chandrababu Naidu, the first CM of the residual state of Andhra Pradesh, held a week-long programme or a pledge to rebuild a new state all over the state, where he made people take a vow to build a new and developed Andhra Pradesh. What was the name of the programme?
x: Nava Nirmana Deeksha was the week-long pledge programme (from 2 June each year) of the residual Andhra Pradesh under CM Chandrababu Naidu to rebuild the State. (Moved to 2:169.)

src: APPSC Forest Beat Officer & Assistant Beat Officer (Mains) 2

x: Article 1 says 'India, that is Bharat, shall be a Union of States'.

src: APPSC Group-III Mains Panchayat Secretary (Grade-IV) Paper-I

x: The Gram Sabha identifies and selects beneficiaries for social security and poverty schemes at the village level.

src: APPSC Assistant Statistical Officer 2012
s: According to Union HRD Minister, by 2022 India needs to have a total workforce of ---- skilled workers.
x: The National Skill Development Policy (2009) set a target of 500 million skilled workers by 2022.

src: Civil Services (Preliminary) 2001
s: Among the following what are the proposed three stages of socio-cultural evolution by L.H. Morgan?
x: In Ancient Society (1877) L.H. Morgan gave three stages of social evolution: savagery, barbarism and civilisation ('wild, barbaric and civilised'). The other options are not Morgan's scheme.

src: APPSC Hostel Welfare Officers (Grade-II) General Studies & M
s: Who are eligible to become Emeritus Professors under a UGC scheme?
x: The UGC Emeritus Fellowship / Professor scheme is for superannuated (retired) teachers who remain active in research.

src: UPSC Civil Services 2005
s:
Consider the following statements:

A. Poverty Reduction and Growth Facility (PRGF) has been established by the International Development Association (IDA) to provide further assistance to low-income countries facing high level of indebtedness

x: The PRGF was set up by the IMF (1999), not the IDA, so A is false; the IMF-Singapore Regional Training Institute trains officials in macroeconomic analysis and policy, so B is true.

src: APPSC Town Planning 2012
s: Parliament of India consists of
o: Directly elected and nominated members only
Directly elected and indirectly elected members only
Directly elected, indirectly elected and nominated members
x: Parliament has directly elected members (Lok Sabha), indirectly elected members (Rajya Sabha) and nominated members (12 in the Rajya Sabha).

src: APPSC Hostel Welfare Officers (Grade-II) General Studies & M

src: APPSC Assistant Social, B.C. & Tribal Welfare Officers Mains
s: Regarding schedule Caste and schedule tribe reservation choose the correct answer
o: Reservation on the basis of domicile is not impermissible in terms of clause of Article 15 of the Constitution of India
Children born to inter caste Marriage of which either father or mother belongs to SC/ST category can claim reservation benefits unconditionally
A person by reason of marriage alone ipso facto become a member of SC or ST
Reservations are available at the time of appointments and promotions even for solitary post
x: Only statement (a) is right: Article 15 does not bar residence (domicile) as such – only 'place of birth' – and the Supreme Court has allowed limited domicile preference (Pradeep Jain, 1984). Children of inter-caste marriages cannot claim SC/ST benefits automatically (Rameshbhai Naika, 2012); marriage alone does not make a person SC/ST (Valsamma Paul, 1996); a solitary post cannot be reserved.
